text:
jamie (PM): Quick design review: compact mode for Autoscaling controls — thinking about surfacing min/max, burst, and GPU pool selector in a tighter card. Goal: less vertical space on small consoles. Thoughts? kevin (Design): I'm wary of cramming too much. If we collapse min/max into a single slider, we save space, but accessibility might suffer (two-handle slider needs clear labels). amaz: typo: I meant @kevin alex (Eng): Two-handle slider is doable but keyboard focus needs to be explicit. Implementation note: we can use aria-valuetext on each handle and tabindex=0 for separate focus. Example: ```
min handle
max handle
``` kevin (Design): Good call. Copy suggestion: label the compact control "Min / Max (instances)" and show a small help pill: "SLO: target p95 latency" with an info icon that opens more. maria (Product): We need a burst checkbox too — "Enable burst (short-term capacity)" — default off. If enabled show burst buffer size input. For Dedicated customers, show pool selector under a separate line to reduce accidental switching. sam (DevEx): UX: If we hide GPU pool selector by default in compact mode, make it discoverable. Maybe a chevron "Advanced" that expands to show pool picker + precise quotas. Also ensure keyboard users can expand/collapse. kevin (Design): Agree. What about constraints/guardrails? We should show inline validation: if min > max show red pill: "Min cannot exceed Max" and offer a quick fix link "swap values". ajamie (PM): +1 on inline quick fixes. Also propose an SLO slider with three presets: Low latency (aggressive), Balanced, Cost-savvy. Selecting one sets recommended min/max and burst policy, with small inline rationale. alex (Eng): Presets map to configs we can version. On the backend we can flag when a rollout violates capacity guardrails and provide fallback to last-known-good. UX should make fallback visible: a toast like "Fallback to Balanced due to capacity constraint" with link to rollouts. aurora (a11y-bot): Accessibility nits: 1) Ensure color contrast of the SLO slider thumb meets AA. 2) Add visible focus ring for compact mode elements. 3) Provide text alternatives for the 3 preset icons. kevin (Design): For copy tweaks: change "Burst" to "Burst capacity (short-term)" and tooltip: "Temporary extra instances to absorb spikes — not guaranteed." maria (Product): One more—when pool selector changes, show a small badge "GPU: A100x8 (zone eu-west)" and an info link to pool details. That helps enterprise users avoid surprises. sam (DevEx): Interaction detail: when user drags min/max, show a transient sample latency estimate and cost delta inline (small grayed text). That helps reviewers pick settings. kevin (Design): Visual suggestion: in compact mode, stack min/max slider and SLO presets horizontally on wide screens, but collapse vertically on narrow viewports. Use ARIA live region to announce preset changes. jamie (PM): Action items: 1) Kevin to update mocks for compact + expanded states (due Tue). 2) Alex to prototype keyboard slider with aria labels (due Wed). 3) Sam to draft microcopy for burst, presets, and fallback messages. 4) Aurora to run quick accessibility checklist on the updated mocks. kevin (Design): I'll push a Figma file and add annotations for a11y and the swap-values quick action. alex (Eng): I'll start a small branch for the two-handle slider and the aria live updates. Will ping when ready for pair. maria (Product): Thanks team. If we can keep compact mode no taller than 160px when collapsed that would be ideal for dashboard rows. jaimie (PM): Slight correction: my name is jamie :)
